title: Managing an Employee Who Resists Change
summary: A respected eleven-year veteran is quietly working around the new workflow platform and influencing peers to do the same. Turn a skeptic into a contributor.

objectives.text: Distinguish legitimate concerns from resistance driven by loss or uncertainty.
Involve a resistant employee in shaping how a change is implemented.
Communicate a non-negotiable change while acknowledging what is being lost.

title: Coaching an Employee Who Wants a Promotion
summary: Your strongest closer asks why he has not been promoted yet. Coach him toward a realistic development plan without dampening his ambition.

objectives.text: Give candid, evidence-based feedback on promotion readiness.
Use the GROW model to co-create a development plan.
Manage disappointment without making promises you cannot keep.

title: Addressing Accountability and Missed Deadlines
summary: A coordinator keeps saying "sure" and keeps missing deadlines. Re-engage them and agree on commitments they genuinely own.

objectives.text: Describe a pattern of missed commitments with specific examples.
Explore the drivers of disengagement before setting new expectations.
Agree on observable commitments and a follow-up mechanism.
